description: This file defines a 'Filter' type for replacing values in YAML nodes, with functions to select source nodes, apply replacements, handle structured data within scalar fields, and serialize data back to JSON or YAML formats. It is part of the 'sigs.k8s.io/kustomize' project, specifically within the 'replacement' filter implementation.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A filter that performs replacements in YAML nodes based on specified replacements.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Method to perform the replacement filtering on a list of YAML nodes.

methods.name: getReplacement
methods.description: Retrieves the replacement value from source nodes based on the replacement specification.

methods.name: selectSourceNode
methods.description: Selects a source node matching the given selector, ensuring a single match.

methods.name: getRefinedValue
methods.description: Refines the replacement value based on field options like delimiter and index.

methods.name: applyReplacement
methods.description: Applies the replacement value to target nodes based on target selectors.

methods.name: selectByAnnoAndLabel
methods.description: Filters nodes based on annotation and label selectors.

methods.name: matchesAnnoAndLabelSelector
methods.description: Checks if a node matches given annotation and label selectors.

methods.name: copyValueToTarget
methods.description: Copies a value to target nodes at specified field paths, handling structured data.

methods.name: fieldRetrievalError
methods.description: Generates error message when a field cannot be found or created.

methods.name: setFieldValue
methods.description: Sets a value in a target field, handling scalar and structured data.

methods.name: setValueInStructuredData
methods.description: Sets a value within structured data (JSON/YAML) embedded in scalar fields.

methods.name: serializeStructuredData
methods.description: Serializes structured data back to string, preserving JSON or YAML format.

methods.name: serializeAsJSON
methods.description: Serializes structured data as JSON, attempting to preserve pretty or compact formatting.
